result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked T11, T12 and T13 by hand against the input files. T11's average of 330.2 matches the five `ms=` values. T12's total of 204.91 matches the shipped rows with a price. T13's top two are Birch at 109.97 and Acme at 104.96.

I ran the T13 query, but not the T4, T6 and T8 queries, with `| tr -d '\n '` on the output, so the whitespace in those results isn't shown. T10's answer is `{:db 3 :api 1 :worker 1}`.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(at :active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | * (/name) | sort ~(lower)
T3: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy * count
T4: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (/labels * /name | * lower) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy * count
T8: unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | * {:n (/0 | keyword) :v /1} | filter ~(/v | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/n) | * ([/n /v] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/1) | * (* (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) (/)]) | join "-"
